ns2:course.label: Analyt Methods for Uncertainty
ns2:course.description: Introduction to basic concepts that underlie important applications of probability and statistics to the analysis of data in the context of engineering design and decision making; point and interval estimation and hypothesis testing for sampled data; categorical data analysis and goodness of fit; linear models, including multivariate regression and analysis of designed experiments; quality methods including sampling, control charts, and process specification. Prerequisite: CS 101, GE 161, MATH 225, and MATH 230, or consent of instructor
